## Summary

Describe the problem and the outcome of this change.

## Tracking

Link the relevant issue, discussion, or ADR. Use `Closes #...` when appropriate.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or tooling
- [ ] Build, packaging, or release

## Architecture and risk

Describe affected boundaries and any impact on public APIs, stored state,
reconciliation behavior, security, compatibility, deployment, or rollback.
Write `None` only after considering each area.

## Verification

List the checks performed and enough information to reproduce them.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to agreed scope.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Documentation and public contracts were updated when needed.
- [ ] New dependencies were reviewed for necessity, license, maintenance, and security.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or environment-specific secrets are included.
- [ ] Failure and rollback behavior were considered.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are explicitly documented.
